subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful embedded after-compaction hooks receive this new deferred reset API, and if so must it be unavailable for model-locked sessions rather than accepting a request that cannot rotate the session?
rationale: This creates a compatibility-sensitive plugin contract, and code inspection cannot decide whether locked-session reset should remain prohibited, be owner-aware, or be documented as best-effort acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor the gated API
options.body: Keep the narrow after-compaction capability, move it to a leaf module, and expose it only when the current session is resettable.

options.title: Define best-effort semantics
options.body: Allow requests for locked sessions but explicitly define queue acceptance rather than session rotation as the API contract and provide observable failure reporting.

options.title: Keep reset out of hooks
options.body: Decline the new plugin API and require compaction plugins to signal an owner-controlled lifecycle action through another existing or newly designed seam.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated API
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow after-compaction capability, move it to a leaf module, and expose it only when the current session is resettable.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the gateway reset contract, session state lifecycle, compaction behavior, and plugin-facing scope represented in this contributor's recent history.
